notes: N-14 registration statement (joint proxy statement/prospectus, subject to completion, dated 2022-01-21) for the reorganisation of Nuveen Enhanced Municipal Value Fund (NEV, target) into Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NZF, acquirer). Meeting date, record date and expected effective date are blank placeholders ([●], 2022) in the excerpt, so null; expected_close would be 'on or about [●], 2022'. Exchange basis is nav_for_nav: aggregate NAV of acquirer common shares received equals aggregate NAV of target common shares, with cash in lieu of fractions. Acquirer preferred shares (MFP and VRDP) vote on the reorganisation but stay outstanding; the security class acted on is the target common shares. Condition 'other' covers third-party consents and waivers including the Series 3 VRDP liquidity provider; the text also says the tax opinion is a non-waivable condition. No outside date is stated in the excerpt.
